Strategy: Reward bins in the middle-upper slice of the spread, 50 to 70 percent from tightest to loosest.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    mn = min(bins)
    mx = max(bins)
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if mx > mn and (r - mn) * 10 >= (mx - mn) * 5 and (r - mn) * 10 <= (mx - mn) * 7 else 0) for r in bins]
```
